text:
Alex K: FYI I noticed a few customer errors after last night's infra push — sticky routing (route-affinity) now expects a v2 token format in X-RW-Route and older clients fail parsing it.
Mira S: ugh, saw a couple Sentry alerts too. can you paste an example header?
Alex K: sure — old vs new:
```
Old: X-RW-Route: pool=dedicated-12;key=abc123
New: X-RW-Route: v2:pool=dedicated-12:affinity=sticky:nonce=9f2a
```
Samir R: Go SDK panicked when stickiness is enabled because parseRouteHeader assumed "key=" present. We didn't add a safe fallback.
Olivia P: Are we sure this was rolled without a compatibility flag? thought we had a graceful parse-mode flag in config.
Jordan (deploy-bot): deploy-id=infra-2026-03-17-23. Config flag route_affinity_v2=true in cluster config.
Alex K: looks like the flag flipped globally mid-deploy. we missed gating by client-negotiation header.
Mira S: quick mitigation: servers can accept both formats. propose we add tolerant parser accepting either "v2:" prefix or old key= kv pairs.
Samir R: I'll open a tiny patch in go-client to handle both formats. patch will be non-breaking but we should do a rollout to pip/go modules.
Olivia P: console/ops: can we add a per-customer migration status widget? product wants to show % of requests using v2 token so support can triage.
Alex K: +1, helpful for support and for doing a staged rollout. also need telemetry: emits a metric route_affinity_token_version with values {old,v2}.
Mira S: for SDKs we should add a feature-detect header so servers can know which parser to expect: X-RW-Client-Route-Version: 0|2. we'll include opt-in in next SDK rev.
Samir R: note — python sdk currently auto-enables stickiness if you pass session_id; we need to ensure python doesn't send v2 format until client lib bump lands. otherwise customers on pinned deploys will break.
Jordan (deploy-bot): rollback window ends in 2h for infra-2026-03-17-23.
Alex K: action items:
- Samir: patch go-client tolerant parser + release quick patch (semver patch).
- Mira: add server-side tolerant parser and metric emit (route_affinity_token_version).
- Olivia: console widget: per-project % v2 adoption, and a per-route toggle for forcing v1 compatibility.
- Alex: coordinate staged flag flip and notify CS.
Samir R: will PR in ~30m. workaround in userspace until SDK release: set header X-RW-Route to old form explicitly when constructing requests.
Mira S: added ticket INF-4123 for tolerant server parsing and metric.
Olivia P: I'll mock up the console tile — may be a quick table: project | route | v1_pct | v2_pct | last_seen.
Alex K: thanks all. ping me if you see more Sentry traces. :pray:
Jordan (deploy-bot): note: related alert group id=alert-5542 reopened (route parser errors).
Samir R: PR link: https://git.redwood/infrago/go-client/pull/279 (wip)
Mira S: rolling patch to servers now, will monitor metrics and Sentry.
Olivia P: putting a small note in the console changelog about route-affinity format change and SDK guidance.
Alex K: great, let's aim to have SDK patches out and console visibility up before the rollback window closes.
